# Trainline

> > Trainline is Europe's leading independent rail and bus booking platform, offering tickets from 200+ operators including SNCF, Deutsche Bahn, Trenitalia, Renfe, and Eurostar across 45 countries.

Trainline serves as a multi-carrier search and booking engine for European rail and bus travel, featuring tools like Best Fare Finder for split-ticketing, Ticket Alert for advance fare notifications, and support for rail passes and loyalty cards. The platform operates in 15+ languages across major European markets and North America.

## Key Topics

- European train booking
- Multi-carrier ticket search
- SNCF (French railways)
- Deutsche Bahn (DB)
- Trenitalia and Italo
- Renfe (Spanish railways)
- Eurostar international trains
- Bus tickets (Flixbus, ALSA)
- Price comparison and split-ticketing
- Rail passes (Eurail, Interrail)
- Advance ticket alerts
- Discount and loyalty cards
- Mobile booking platform
- Cross-border European travel
- Real-time schedules and fares

## Main Platform & Core Markets

- [Trainline | Search, Compare & Buy Cheap Train & Bus Tickets](https://www.thetrainline.com): Main homepage for booking train & bus tickets across 200+ EU operators
- [Trainline | Réservez votre Billet de Train | Horaires et Prix | France EU](https://www.thetrainline.com/fr): French homepage - official SNCF distributor for train/bus booking
- [Bahn- und Bustickets suchen, vergleichen und buchen | Trainline](https://www.thetrainline.com/de): German homepage for DB, Flixbus, SBB, ÖBB ticket booking
- [Busca, Compara y Compra Billetes de Tren y Autobús | Trainline](https://www.thetrainline.com/es): Spanish homepage - official Renfe, ALSA, SNCF distributor
- [Biglietti treni e pullman in Italia e Europa, orari e offerte | Trainline](https://www.thetrainline.com/it): Italian homepage - authorized Trenitalia, Italo, Flixbus distributor
- [Trainline | Search, Compare & Buy Cheap Train & Bus Tickets](https://www.thetrainline.com/en-us): US English homepage for European rail booking with Eurail Passes
- [Pesquise, compare e compre bilhetes baratos de comboio e autocarro com a Trainline](https://www.thetrainline.com/pt): Portuguese homepage for booking SNCF, Deutsche Bahn, Eurostar train tickets

## Booking Tools & Features

- [Best Fare Finder | Cheap Train Tickets Fare Finder | Trainline](https://www.thetrainline.com/farefinder): Best Fare Finder tool for cheap UK train tickets with split-ticketing
- [Ticket Alert | Get Email Alerts for Cheap Train Tickets | Trainline](https://www.thetrainline.com/ticketalert): Ticket Alert tool for email notifications on UK Advance ticket releases
